messages:
laura: ok team — kicking off the Q2 GTM planning thread. Need alignment across sales targets, the PLG experiment slate, and enablement schedule. Draft plan: https://redwood.example/q2-g... Can folks review and post blockers by EOD tomorrow?
sam: quick question — can we increase experiment budget for PLG emails? last test showed 2.8x better conversion with small spend. :money_with_wings:
diego: FYI from product: we need at least 2 weeks lead time to lock any feature we call out in marketing. if we want a canary in mid-May we need freeze by 2026-05-06.
emily: from sales POV, propose targets: 25% ARR growth overall, and 8 Dedicated upsells (reserved capacity) in Q2. those are aggressive but achievable with enablement and a focused play.
mike: marketing can support that cadence. We'll need the product one-pager, pricing snapshot, and 2 short customer quotes by 05/20. I'll run webinar schedule.
laura: noted. proposed timeline: canary 2026-05-20, GA 2026-06-10. if we can't hold that, we should postpone campaigns. thoughts?
diego: that works if we freeze features 2026-05-06 and get QA window of 2 weeks. mobile SDKs won't make canary unless we deprioritize a11y polish.
sam: PLG experiments I want to run in parallel (low-risk): 1) onboarding nudge cohort A/B, 2) trial auto-topup variant, 3) feature-flagged upsell modal. metrics: activation rate, trial->paid conversion, ARPA change. need events: onboarding.complete, trial.topup, upsell.click.
growth-bot: experiment created: q2-onboard-nudge id=exp_9273 owner=sam
emily: can we align SDR outreach with the PLG cohorts? if we surface trial anomalies, SDRs can target high-intent users. Need exported cohort list weekly.
ops-jordan: we can support cohort export but need event schema finalized by 2026-04-28.
mike: marketing asks: 1) enablement playbook (battlecards + 2 objection scripts), 2) 2 webinar slots (one for PLG, one for Dedicated), 3) landing page copy + pricing. pulling all into content tracker.
laura: scope negotiation: if sales upsell target moves to 12, product will need to prioritize Dedicated performance previews and a demos environment — that adds ~3 weeks. keep targets at 8 unless execs sign off.
diego: agree. also request: a short release note template for embedded messaging team so we don't ship features without marketing context.
laura: good call. Mike, can you own the release-note template? Emily, can you confirm SE availability for enablement week of 2026-06-01?
mike: yes, I'll draft template and have it in the content tracker by 2026-04-25.
emily: I'll confirm SEs today and post names.
sam: status syncs: can we do a 30-min cross-functional on 2026-04-29 to lock experiments and events? propose 10:00 PT.
laura: scheduled 2026-04-29 10:00 PT. calendar invite sent.
laura: ACTIONS (short):
- sam: final experiment specs + event list by 2026-04-28
- diego: feature freeze plan and QA milestone by 2026-05-06
- mike: release-note template + content tracker updates by 2026-04-25
- emily: SE names + battlecard inputs by 2026-04-26
- ops-jordan: cohort export doc + schema checks by 2026-04-28
- laura: sync with sales leadership about targets by 2026-04-24

please reply with any blockers or if dates are unrealistic. thanks! :rocket:
